title: Jagadānanda Kāraka
text_first_line: Jagadānanda kāraka jaya jānakī prāṇa nāyaka
text_meaning: O bestower of bliss to the world, O lord of Jānakī's life

title: Dudukugala
text_meaning: Is there a refuge for this wretched one?

title: Sādhinchane
text_meaning: O mind, have you accomplished it?

title: Kanakanaruchirā
text_meaning: O one who shines like gold

title: Endaro Mahānubhāvulu
text_meaning: Many are the great souls — I salute them all

title: Kamalāmbike
text_meaning: O Kamalāmbikā, wish-fulfilling vine of those who seek refuge

title: Śrī Subrahmaṇyāya Namaste
text_meaning: Salutations to Śrī Subrahmaṇya

title: Devi Brova Samayamide
text_meaning: O Devī, this is the time to protect me

title: Bhaja Govindam
text_first_line: Bhaja govindaṃ bhaja govindaṃ govindaṃ bhaja mūḍhamate
text_meaning: Worship Govinda, O fool, for grammar will not save you at death

title: Vātāpi Gaṇapatiṃ Bhaje
text_meaning: I worship Gaṇapati of Vātāpi

title: Nagumomu Ganaleni
text_meaning: Knowing my plight, will you not show your smiling face?

title: Brōvabhāramā
text_meaning: Is it a burden to protect me, O Rāma?

title: Mānasa Sañcārarē
text_meaning: O mind, roam in Brahman

title: Śrī Cakra Rāja
text_meaning: O queen enthroned on the Śrī Cakra

title: Sarōja Daḷa Nētri
text_first_line: Sarōja daḷa nētri hima giri putri
text_meaning: O lotus-eyed daughter of the snow mountain

title: Raghuvaṃśa Sudhā
text_meaning: O moon of the ocean of the Raghu dynasty

title: Ethi Janma
text_meaning: How many births is this, O Rāma?

title: Mariveṛē Gati
text_meaning: Who else is my refuge?

title: Śōbhillu Saptasvara
text_meaning: The seven beautiful svaras shine forth

title: Eri Aali Piya Bin
text_meaning: O friend, without the beloved

title: Jāgo Mohan Pyāre
text_meaning: Awake, O beloved Mohan, awake

title: Bairān Ho Gayi Raina
text_meaning: The night has become hostile

title: Payo Ji Maine Rām Ratan Dhan Pāyo
title_iast: Pāyo Jī Maine Rām Ratan Dhan Pāyo
text_first_line: Pāyo jī maine rām ratan dhan pāyo
text_meaning: I have found the jewel-wealth of Rām's name

title: Kaun Gat Bhayo Hamare
text_meaning: What has become of me?

title: Kāhe Re Ban Khojan Jāi
text_meaning: Why go searching in the forest?

title: Piyā Bin Nahīn Āvat Chain
text_meaning: Without the beloved, no peace comes

title: Ab To Meri Naiyā Pār Karo
title_iast: Ab To Merī Naiyyā Pār Karo
text_first_line: Ab to merī naiyyā pār karo
text_meaning: Now take my boat across

title: Chādariyā Jhīnī Re Jhīnī
text_meaning: The cloth of life is delicate, so delicate

title: Man Lagā Merā Yār Phakīrī Mein
title_iast: Man Lagā Merā Yār Phakīrī Mein
text_first_line: Man lagā merā yār phakīrī mein
text_meaning: My heart is absorbed in divine poverty

title: More Bālam Ghara Āyē
text_meaning: My beloved has come home

title: Bābul Morā Naihar Chūṭo Jāi
text_meaning: Father, my childhood home slips away

title: Jamunā Kinare Morā Gāon
text_meaning: My village is on the banks of the Yamunā

title: Mhāro Praṇām
text_meaning: My salutations

title: Pāyo Jī Maine
title_iast: Pāyo Jī Maine Rām Ratan Dhan Pāyo
text_first_line: Pāyo jī maine rām ratan dhan pāyo
text_meaning: I have found the jewel-wealth of Rām's name

title: Śrī Rāma Stuti
text_meaning: The lake of Rāma's deeds

title: Main Nahīn Mākhana Khāyo
text_meaning: I did not eat the butter

title: Moko Kahān Dhūndhe Re Bande
text_meaning: Where do you search for me, O seeker?

title: Viṭhṭhalā Viṭhṭhalā
text_meaning: Viṭhṭhala, Viṭhṭhala

title: Āṇi Eka Māgan
text_meaning: I have only one request

title: Pāsāyadāna
text_meaning: Now the all-pervading form, may the evil-minded become virtuous

title: Hari Tum Haro Jan Kī Pīr
title_iast: Hari Tum Haro Jan Kī Pīr
text_first_line: Hari tum haro jan kī pīr
text_meaning: O Hari, remove the pain of your devotee

title: Sādho Dekho Jag Baurānā
text_meaning: O seeker, see how the world has gone mad

title: Ākh Harī Darśan Kī Pyāsī
text_meaning: My eyes thirst for the sight of Hari

title: Mere To Giridhar Gopāl
text_first_line: Mere to giridhar gopāl dūsarā na koī
text_meaning: My lord is Giridhar Gopāl, there is no other

title: Mahāmṛtyuñjaya Mantra
text_meaning: We worship the three-eyed one who nourishes and increases fragrance

title: Viṣṇu Sahasranāma
text_meaning: The universe, Viṣṇu, the sacrificial fire, lord of past present and future

title: Lalitā Sahasranāma
text_first_line: Śrī mātā śrī mahārājñī śrīmat siṃhāsaneśvarī
text_meaning: The divine mother, the great queen, seated on the lion throne

title: Gaṇeśa Pañcaratnam
text_meaning: He who holds the modaka with delight, ever bestowing liberation

title: Hanumān Cālīsā
text_first_line: Śrī guru carana saroja raja nija manu mukuru sudhāri
text_meaning: Cleansing the mirror of my mind with the pollen-dust of the guru's lotus feet

title: Gāyatrī Mantra
text_first_line: Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat saviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
text_meaning: We meditate on the divine light of Savitṛ; may it inspire our thoughts

title: Śrī Sūkta
text_meaning: She of golden hue, adorned with gold and silver garlands

title: Puruṣa Sūkta
text_meaning: The cosmic person with a thousand heads, eyes, and feet

title: Navagraha Stotra
text_first_line: Japā kusuma saṅkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahā dyutim
text_meaning: Like the hibiscus flower, descendant of Kaśyapa, of great brilliance (Sūrya)

title: Śiva Pañcākṣarī Stotra
text_meaning: To the one garlanded with serpents, three-eyed, ash-smeared, great lord

title: Shiva Shiva Shiva
text_meaning: Will you not say Śiva Śiva Śiva?

title: Brahmam Okate
text_meaning: Brahman is one, the supreme Brahman is one

title: Āī Re Kharī Baiyān Nainā
text_meaning: My eyes fill with tears standing at the threshold

title: Kahe Sataāve Mohe
text_meaning: Why do you torment me?

title: Ud Jāyegā Hans Akelā
text_meaning: The swan will fly away alone

title: Maṅgal Bhavan Amaṅgal Hārī
text_meaning: The abode of auspiciousness, destroyer of inauspiciousness
